repairs: Report, post-outcome review paragraph: '(so the gradient is not the CpG-density signal already reported)' overclaims. The probe adjusted for CpG-island COUNT, whereas Shen et al. 2026 report CpG DENSITY across LAD bodies. Reword to e.g. 'the gradient survives adjustment for CpG-island count; CpG density itself was not tested as a covariate'.

Report and PR body: the cubic-baseline probe is cited as support (-0.303 / -0.281) but its within-batch placebo also rose to -0.091 (p_neg 0.001 against the off-centre null), still under the 0.13 bound. Disclose this next to the cubic figure.
minor: PR body omits two caveats from the post-outcome review that the report carries: the two primaries share KO replicate LMNAKO_r2 and are not independent evidence, and GC-versus-change is sensitive to GC-dependent dynamic-range differences, which z-scoring does not remove. Add one line to the Limits bullet.

Prior-art framing is fair and matches design/prior-art-gc-lamina.md, which is published byte-identical to the private copy. It should stay published. The report does not mention the note's open gaps: Solovei 2013 body text and the Cell Reports 2025 lamin-KO paper were paywalled, T1/T2 is unverified, and GEO pages were not read directly. Add 'prior-art search incomplete; see open gaps'.

The quote 'little change' refers to overall magnitude. A rank gradient of about -0.25 is compatible with a small absolute change, and the report gives no absolute delta size. Consider saying 'contrasts in emphasis' rather than implying contradiction.

Report structure: '## Record, in the order it happened' is an empty heading followed by sibling ## sections. The 'Current reading' (erosion candidate) section precedes its rejection with no 'superseded, see panel test' marker.
code/build_features.py redaction leaves '<home>/Documents/research' (the path had no trailing slash, so the <research-root> rule did not match). This is harmless but inconsistent.
Manifest 'bytes' records the original size, so the 5 redacted files differ in size from their published copies (sha256_published matches). Consider adding bytes_published.

Placebo bound 0.130 is correct, as is the label REPLICATED in both arms. Negative results are disclosed, and LEAK_PATTERN is stated as not supported first.
